target_net_and_buffer_targets.notes: Select high-drive, low-skew clock buffer standard cells from the SkyWater 130nm standard library collection.

cts_performance_targets.max_allowed_clock_skew_notes: Max allowable time difference between any two registers on the chip. Set to an aggressive 150 picoseconds to guarantee perfect timing closure.
cts_performance_targets.max_clock_transition_notes: Maximum electrical rise and fall time for the clock signal edge. Set to 1.0 nanosecond to keep the clock edges crisp and drop dynamic power leakage.

chip_execution_layer.description: Executing structural clock routing optimization. Injecting balanced tree buffer cells dynamically across layout.

post_cts_timing_and_legalization.notes: Once the clock tree is built, hold-time violations can appear. This instructs the router to automatically insert delay buffers on fast data tracks.
